name: RZ-1 crisp digital electro
desc: Casio RZ-1 12-bit digital electro kit: tight crunchy kick syncopation, snappy clap/snare backbeat, crisp ghost-note hats, a ride that swells in and out over 32 cycles, and a masked tom fill that only surfaces at phrase ends.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ ~ bd ~ ~").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}).shape(.2), s("~ [cp,sd] ~ [cp,sd]").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.55).room(${room}), s("hh*8").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(".4 .18 .28 .18 .38 .18 .3 .2").pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)), s("rd*4").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(sine.range(.08,.24).slow(32)), s("~ ~ ~ [mt ht]").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.45).mask("<0 0 0 1>")).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ [bd bd] ~").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}).shape(.25), s("~ [cp,sd] ~ [cp,sd]").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.6).room(${room}), s("hh*16").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(saw.range(.15,.42).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)), s("cb(5,16,<0 4 8 12>)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.32), s("[~ oh]*4").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.3)).lastOf(${fill}, x=>x.rev()).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
